text: Joseph would rather not have anyone in the house or send photos.
Accepted, no pressure. Exterior-only drive-by from the street by the field agent ($75, inside the limit; no entry onto the property).
Repairs remain a guess: $45,000-$80,000. No firm number. Negotiator offers a range with an inspection period instead.

Without seeing inside, the fairest I can do is a range: $160,000-$185,000, as-is. I'd confirm the exact price after a 30-minute inspection within 10 days of signing, scheduled when Joseph agrees, and the family could cancel if they don't like the confirmed number.
Inspection inside the contract's period: roof at end of life (about $14,000 more than assumed).

The inspection found the roof needs replacing (report attached). Within the inspection period, we can stay at $185,000 if the price drops to $175,000, or the family can cancel with nothing owed. We'll respect either choice.
note: Honest, with the report; no surprise demands. The contingency was disclosed at signing.
